 JD.com reports Q3 revenue up 3.5% YoY to ~$46.4B, meeting est., and net income up 22% to ~$975M, amid intense competition and a sluggish Chinese economy   —  JD.com Inc. returned to revenue growth in the third quarter, showing signs of resilience against a backdrop of intense competition and a sluggish Chinese economy.
